content: Curry Barker, the director behind the hit horror film Obsession, just published a new horror short on YouTube. The short, titled “Mama Bear,” is nearly five minutes long. The video is pretty unnerving, and fair warning that it gets a little graphic, but it’s a fun one to watch if you’re looking for something scary ahead of Halloween on Saturday. Barker wrote, directed, and edited “Mama Bear,” according to the description for the video, which was published on his that’s a bad idea YouTube channel. The description also has a note thanking Windows for “sponsoring this short film,” and Barker was featured in an Instagram video earlier this week with a Surface laptop. Barker will follow Obsession with Anything but Ghosts, which debuts in May 2027. Horror is big business right now, with the film Backrooms, directed by YouTuber Kane Parsons, also proving to be a big box office success this year. Parsons debuted a new Backrooms YouTube episode in August.

chineseSummary: 热门恐怖片《痴迷》的导演库里·巴克 (Curry Barker) 刚刚在 YouTube 上发布了一部新的恐怖短片。短片名为“熊妈妈”，时长近五分钟。该视频非常令人不安，并且公平地警告它有一点图形，但如果您正在寻找一些可怕的东西，那么观看它会很有趣[...]
chineseContent: 热门恐怖片《痴迷》的导演库里·巴克 (Curry Barker) 刚刚在 YouTube 上发布了一部新的恐怖短片。短片名为“熊妈妈”，时长近五分钟。这段视频相当令人不安，并且公平地警告说，它有点图形化，但如果你想在周六万圣节前寻找一些恐怖的东西，那么观看它会很有趣。根据视频的描述，巴克自编自导并剪辑了《熊妈妈》，该视频发布在他的 YouTube 频道“那是个坏主意”上。描述中还附有感谢 Windows“赞助这部短片”的说明，本周早些时候，巴克在 Instagram 视频中使用了一台 Surface 笔记本电脑。 《巴克》将继 2027 年 5 月首映的《对任何事都着迷》之后上映。恐怖片现在是一门大生意，由 YouTuber 凯恩·帕森斯执导的电影《幕后》今年也取得了巨大的票房成功。帕森斯于 8 月在 YouTube 上推出了新的 Backrooms 剧集。
